name: Benmoxin
summary: Benmoxin (trade names Neuralex, Nerusil), also known as mebamoxine, is an irreversible and nonselective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class. It was synthesized in 1967 and was subsequently used as an antidepressant in Europe, but is now no longer marketed.

pharmacology.text: Benmoxin (trade names Neuralex, Nerusil), also known as mebamoxine, is an irreversible and nonselective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class.

uses.text: It was synthesized in 1967 and was subsequently used as an antidepressant in Europe, but is now no longer marketed.

sideEffects.en: Hydrazine monoamine oxidase inhibitors can damage the liver, which is why most were withdrawn. They also cause dizziness on standing, sleeplessness and, with tyramine-rich foods such as aged cheese, a dangerous rise in blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑可能損害肝臟，這也是多數已下市的原因。它們還會造成起身時頭暈、失眠，並在與陳年乳酪等富含酪胺的食物並用時造成血壓危險升高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂可能损害肝脏，这也是多数已下市的原因。它们还会造成起身时头晕、失眠，并在与陈年奶酪等富含酪胺的食物并用时造成血压危险升高。

fact.en: It is a hydrazine, the same chemical group as the very first antidepressant, iproniazid. Hydrazine itself is used as rocket fuel, and these drugs block monoamine oxidase permanently.
fact.zh: 苯莫辛屬於肼類，與最早的抗憂鬱劑異丙菸醯異丙肼同屬一個化學基團。肼本身被用作火箭燃料，而這類藥物會永久阻斷單胺氧化酶。
fact.zhHans: 苯莫辛属于肼类，与最早的抗忧郁剂异丙烟酰异丙肼同属一个化学基团。肼本身被用作火箭燃料，而这类药物会永久阻断单胺氧化酶。
